scope: Lean graph, bounded paths, structural validation, one-step role routes, link selection and normalized-key read admission models. TypeScript correspondence is finite conformance testing, not whole-program refinement.

declarations.name: Usl.adjacent_symmetric
declarations.type: ∀ {graph : Usl.Graph} {a b : String}, Usl.Adjacent graph a b → Usl.Adjacent graph b a

declarations.name: Usl.reachable_transitive
declarations.type: ∀ {graph : Usl.Graph} {a b c : String}, Usl.Reachable graph a b → Usl.Reachable graph b c → Usl.Reachable graph a c

declarations.name: Usl.reachable_symmetric
declarations.type: ∀ {graph : Usl.Graph} {a b : String}, Usl.Reachable graph a b → Usl.Reachable graph b a

declarations.name: Usl.selected_link_original
declarations.type:
∀ {graph : Usl.Graph} {ids : List String} {link : Usl.Link},
  link ∈ (Usl.selectLinks graph ids).links → link ∈ graph.links

declarations.name: Usl.selection_preserves_wellformed
declarations.type: ∀ {graph : Usl.Graph} {ids : List String}, Usl.WellFormed graph → Usl.WellFormed (Usl.selectLinks graph ids)

declarations.name: Usl.selected_read_allowed
declarations.type:
∀ {requested allowed : List String} {resource : String},
  resource ∈ Usl.selectReads requested allowed → resource ∈ allowed

declarations.name: Usl.deny_all
declarations.type: ∀ (requested : List String), Usl.selectReads requested [] = []

declarations.name: Usl.narrower_reads
declarations.type:
∀ {requested allowed narrow : List String},
  (∀ (resource : String), resource ∈ narrow → resource ∈ allowed) →
    ∀ {resource : String}, resource ∈ Usl.selectReads requested narrow → resource ∈ Usl.selectReads requested allowed

declarations.name: Usl.reachableWithin_reflexive
declarations.type: ∀ (graph : Usl.Graph) (resource : String) (hops : Nat), Usl.reachableWithin graph resource resource hops = true

declarations.name: Usl.reachableWithin_sound
declarations.type:
∀ {graph : Usl.Graph} {start target : String} {hops : Nat},
  Usl.reachableWithin graph start target hops = true → Usl.Reachable graph start target

declarations.name: Usl.reachableWithin_correct
declarations.type:
∀ {graph : Usl.Graph} {start target : String} {hops : Nat},
  Usl.reachableWithin graph start target hops = true ↔ Usl.PathWithin graph hops start target

declarations.name: Usl.PathWithin.mono
declarations.type: ∀ {graph : Usl.Graph} {a b : String} {n m : Nat}, Usl.PathWithin graph n a b → n ≤ m → Usl.PathWithin graph m a b

declarations.name: Usl.PathWithin.trans
declarations.type:
∀ {graph : Usl.Graph} {a b c : String} {n m : Nat},
  Usl.PathWithin graph n a b → Usl.PathWithin graph m b c → Usl.PathWithin graph (n + m) a c

declarations.name: Usl.PathWithin.symm
declarations.type: ∀ {graph : Usl.Graph} {a b : String} {n : Nat}, Usl.PathWithin graph n a b → Usl.PathWithin graph n b a

declarations.name: Usl.reachableWithin_monotone
declarations.type:
∀ {graph : Usl.Graph} {a b : String} {n m : Nat},
  n ≤ m → Usl.reachableWithin graph a b n = true → Usl.reachableWithin graph a b m = true

declarations.name: Usl.reachableWithin_symmetric
declarations.type:
∀ {graph : Usl.Graph} {a b : String} {n : Nat},
  Usl.reachableWithin graph a b n = true → Usl.reachableWithin graph b a n = true

declarations.name: Usl.reachableWithin_composition
declarations.type:
∀ {graph : Usl.Graph} {a b c : String} {n m : Nat},
  Usl.reachableWithin graph a b n = true →
    Usl.reachableWithin graph b c m = true → Usl.reachableWithin graph a c (n + m) = true

declarations.name: Usl.reachableWithin_complete
declarations.type: ∀ {graph : Usl.Graph} {a b : String}, Usl.Reachable graph a b → ∃ hops, Usl.reachableWithin graph a b hops = true

declarations.name: Usl.reachable_iff_exists_budget
declarations.type: ∀ {graph : Usl.Graph} {a b : String}, Usl.Reachable graph a b ↔ ∃ hops, Usl.reachableWithin graph a b hops = true

declarations.name: Usl.reachableWithin_false_iff
declarations.type:
∀ {graph : Usl.Graph} {a b : String} {hops : Nat},
  Usl.reachableWithin graph a b hops = false ↔ ¬Usl.PathWithin graph hops a b

declarations.name: Usl.reachableWithin_stays_in_graph
declarations.type:
∀ {graph : Usl.Graph} {a b : String} {hops : Nat},
  Usl.WellFormed graph → a ∈ graph.resources → Usl.reachableWithin graph a b hops = true → b ∈ graph.resources

declarations.name: Usl.selected_link_iff
declarations.type:
∀ {graph : Usl.Graph} {ids : List String} {link : Usl.Link},
  link ∈ (Usl.selectLinks graph ids).links ↔ link ∈ graph.links ∧ link.id ∈ ids

declarations.name: Usl.selectLinks_idempotent
declarations.type: ∀ (graph : Usl.Graph) (ids : List String), Usl.selectLinks (Usl.selectLinks graph ids) ids = Usl.selectLinks graph ids

declarations.name: Usl.selectLinks_commute
declarations.type:
∀ (graph : Usl.Graph) (first second : List String),
  Usl.selectLinks (Usl.selectLinks graph first) second = Usl.selectLinks (Usl.selectLinks graph second) first

declarations.name: Usl.selectReads_exact
declarations.type:
∀ {requested allowed : List String} {resource : String},
  resource ∈ Usl.selectReads requested allowed ↔ resource ∈ requested ∧ resource ∈ allowed

declarations.name: Usl.selectReads_idempotent
declarations.type:
∀ (requested allowed : List String),
  Usl.selectReads (Usl.selectReads requested allowed) allowed = Usl.selectReads requested allowed

declarations.name: Usl.selectReads_commute
declarations.type:
∀ (requested first second : List String),
  Usl.selectReads (Usl.selectReads requested first) second = Usl.selectReads (Usl.selectReads requested second) first

declarations.name: Usl.admitted_read_exact
declarations.type:
∀ {requested allowed output : List String} {budget : Nat},
  Usl.admitReads requested allowed budget = some output →
    ∀ {resource : String}, resource ∈ output ↔ resource ∈ requested ∧ resource ∈ allowed

declarations.name: Usl.admitted_reads_budget
declarations.type:
∀ {requested allowed output : List String} {budget : Nat},
  Usl.admitReads requested allowed budget = some output → output.length ≤ budget

declarations.name: Usl.oversized_reads_rejected
declarations.type:
∀ (requested allowed : List String) (budget : Nat),
  budget < requested.eraseDups.length → Usl.admitReads requested allowed budget = none

declarations.name: Usl.validateGraph_correct
declarations.type: ∀ (graph : Usl.Graph), Usl.validateGraph graph = true ↔ Usl.GraphValid graph

declarations.name: Usl.validGraph_wellformed
declarations.type: ∀ {graph : Usl.Graph}, Usl.GraphValid graph → Usl.WellFormed graph

declarations.name: Usl.selection_preserves_validGraph
declarations.type: ∀ {graph : Usl.Graph}, Usl.GraphValid graph → ∀ (ids : List String), Usl.GraphValid (Usl.selectLinks graph ids)

declarations.name: Usl.selection_preserves_validation
declarations.type:
∀ {graph : Usl.Graph},
  Usl.validateGraph graph = true → ∀ (ids : List String), Usl.validateGraph (Usl.selectLinks graph ids) = true

declarations.name: Usl.routedStep_correct
declarations.type:
∀ (graph : Usl.Graph) (routes : List Usl.RoleRoute) (a b : String),
  Usl.routedStep graph routes a b = true ↔ Usl.RoutedAdjacent graph routes a b

declarations.name: Usl.routedStep_original
declarations.type:
∀ {graph : Usl.Graph} {routes : List Usl.RoleRoute} {a b : String},
  Usl.routedStep graph routes a b = true → Usl.Adjacent graph a b

declarations.name: Usl.no_routes_no_step
declarations.type: ∀ (graph : Usl.Graph) (a b : String), Usl.routedStep graph [] a b = false
